dedupe_keys.name: green infrastructure designer with rhessys workflow

description: Green Infrastructure Designer with RHESSys Workflow is a model listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Lorne Leonard (deposited on HydroShare). Using the GI (Green Infrastructure) designer web site, users design green infrastructure via GIS maps and web services to create datasets for RHESSys workflows. RHESSysWorkflows provides a series of Python tools for performing RHESSys data preparation workflows. These tools build on the workflow system defined by EcohydroLib and RHESSysWorkflows. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2017-04-13 and last updated 2017-04-13; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
